source.name: Aston Martin Aramco announces CoreWeave as Official AI Cloud Computing Partner
source.quote: Aston Martin Aramco announces a multi-year partnership with CoreWeave, the first AI Hyperscaler, which joins the team as Official AI Cloud Computing Partner.

note: Official AI Cloud Computing Partner; CoreWeave branding appeared on the AMR25 from the 2025 Monaco Grand Prix. No reported value.
